name: Army
overview: A career in the Army involves defending the nation, maintaining peace, and assisting civil authorities. The Indian Army provides extensive training and education to prepare individuals for military service, covering military tactics, weaponry, leadership, and physical conditioning. This path offers opportunities for personal growth and meaningful contribution to national security.

topJobs.description: Hold positions from Lieutenant to higher ranks
Lead infantry troops during combat operations
Provide medical care to military personnel

institutesIndia: Officers Training Academy (OTA), Chennai and Gaya
careerLadder: Excel in high school academics, particularly mathematics, physics, and physical education
Enroll in undergraduate courses (B.A./B.Sc.) in Defense Studies or Military Science
Participate in physical fitness activities and extracurricular pursuits
Join institutions like NDA or Indian Military Academy
Pursue postgraduate programs (M.A./M.Sc.) in Defense/Strategic Studies
Appear for competitive examinations (CDS or Army CEE)
